verdict.rationale: SumUp is API-first and can run without a UI. Static API keys let an application act on the merchant account, and the @sumup/sdk runs in Node.js 18+, Cloudflare Workers and Vercel. The Cloud API drives payments over plain HTTPS, while sandbox merchant accounts, test cards and Virtual Solo allow automated test flows without a physical reader. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD documentation or a first-party CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
